name: pio_sm1

config.instruction_memory: 32 x 16 bit, writable through host action INSTR
config.gpio: 8 pins brought out (upstream has 32; the other 24 are tied off and trimmed by synthesis)
config.host_interface: upstream action bus: action[3:0], index[4:0], din[31:0], dout[31:0]
patches: pio.v [yosys-patch]: gpio_out/gpio_dir/output_pins_prev/pin_directions_prev were driven by two always blocks; Yosys resolved the conflict to the constant reset value (all GPIO outputs tied 0). Reset moved into the single driving block.
machine.v [yosys-patch]: same two-always-block problem for output_pins/pin_directions; reset moved into the pin-update block (reset/restart priority).
pio.v [asic-patch]: one-cycle strobes (push/pull/imm/restart/clkdiv_restart) cleared every cycle incl. reset (upstream left them at their power-up value through reset); use_divider reset with div.
machine.v [asic-patch]: exec1 cleared on reset/restart (was only an initial value).

notes: Measured with clkdiv = 1 (no divider), 10 MHz-clock testbench, programs loaded through the action bus. UART: canonical pull / start / 8x out / stop, unrolled so each bit is one instruction (1 clk/bit, 10 clk/byte, FIFO pull included). The canonical delay-free loop (pull side1 [1]; set x,7 side0 [1]; out pins,1; jmp x--) gives 2 clk/bit in 4 words. SPI: spi_cpha0 structure (out pins side 0 / in pins side 1) at 2 clk/bit; upstream's GPIO output path has one more register than its input path, so `in` sees the pins of two instructions earlier: the plain 2-clk/bit program reads MISO one bit late (spi_2cpb_negative, fails); the measured program raises SCK for bit 0 with a nop and adds one `in` after the last pulse (19 words, 19 clk/byte incl. pull+push). The textbook variant with [1] delay is 3 clk/bit, 26 clk/byte. Autopull/autopush were not used: upstream autopush only fires at the next `in`, so the last RX byte would stay in ISR.
yosys_cmd: incumbents/yosys.sh -p "read_verilog -sv incumbents/pio_sm1/patched/pio.v incumbents/pio_sm1/patched/machine.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/decoder.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/divider.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/pc.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/scratch.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/fifo.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/isr.v incumbents/upstream/fpga_pio/src/osr.v incumbents/pio_sm1/top.v; synth -flatten -top inc_pio_sm1; stat"

name: serv_bb

config.core: SERV via upstream serv_rf_top, W=1 (classic bit-serial)
config.register_file: serv_rf_ram 512 x 2 bit = 1024 bits (32 x 32, plain Verilog array)
config.prog_mem: 32 x 32 bit = 1024 bits, plain reg array, host-writable (prog_we/prog_addr/prog_wdata), combinational read
config.bus: Harvard: ibus -> program memory, dbus -> I/O only (no data RAM); ack = cyc on both (zero wait states)
config.io: zero-wait-state I/O, x0-relative: -16 GPIO_OUT[7:0] (W/R), -12 GPIO_IN[7:0] (R), -8 TX mailbox {valid,23b0,data} (R, read clears valid; 1-deep, host_tx_full), -4 RX mailbox (W, sets host_rx_valid)

notes: Firmware hand-assembled (incumbents/common/rvasm.py), loaded through the host port, listings in incumbents/programs/rv32i_<case>.lst. UART: poll mailbox, precompute d1..d7 with seven 1-bit srli, then ten back-to-back identical sw (start, d0..d7, stop) so the bit period is exactly one store; stop bit is stretched by the next poll/precompute (clocks_per_byte includes it). Alternative sw/srli pairs: see alternatives. SPI: 8 instructions/bit (andi MOSI, sw SCK low, ori, sw SCK high, lw GPIO_IN, andi, add, or), loop unrolled 2x with a counter to fit the 32-word memory; the fully unrolled version needs 71 words (see alternatives, simulated with PROG_WORDS=72). Pins: UART TX=gpio_out[0]; SPI SCK=gpio_out[0], MOSI=gpio_out[7], MISO=gpio_in[0]. Other GPIO_OUT bits are don't-care during UART TX (whole-register writes).
yosys_cmd: incumbents/yosys.sh -p "read_verilog -sv incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_bufreg.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_bufreg2.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_alu.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_csr.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_ctrl.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_decode.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_immdec.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_mem_if.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_rf_if.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_rf_ram_if.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_rf_ram.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_state.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_debug.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_top.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_rf_top.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_aligner.v incumbents/upstream/serv/rtl/serv_compdec.v incumbents/serv_bb/top.v; synth -flatten -top inc_serv_bb; stat"

name: femtorv_bb

config.register_file: 31 x 32 bit (x0 storage removed by the x0 patch)
config.prog_mem: 32 x 32 bit = 1024 bits, plain reg array, host-writable, combinational read; shared instruction/data port as Quark requires (I/O when addr[7]=1)
config.io: zero-wait-state I/O, x0-relative: -16 GPIO_OUT[7:0] (W/R), -12 GPIO_IN[7:0] (R), -8 TX mailbox {valid,23b0,data} (R, read clears valid; 1-deep, host_tx_full), -4 RX mailbox (W, sets host_rx_valid)
patches: [icarus-patch] declarations moved ahead of first use (Icarus 13 rejects use-before-declaration); logic unchanged

[asic-patch] x0 reads forced to 0 and x0 storage dropped (registerFile [31:1]): upstream never writes x0 and relies on FPGA power-up init; in the generic netlist x0 was a never-written 32-bit register (random at power-up)

notes: Firmware hand-assembled (incumbents/common/rvasm.py), loaded through the host port, listings in incumbents/programs/rv32i_<case>.lst. UART: poll mailbox, precompute d1..d7 with seven 1-bit srli, then ten back-to-back identical sw (start, d0..d7, stop) so the bit period is exactly one store; stop bit is stretched by the next poll/precompute (clocks_per_byte includes it). Alternative sw/srli pairs: see alternatives. SPI: 8 instructions/bit (andi MOSI, sw SCK low, ori, sw SCK high, lw GPIO_IN, andi, add, or), loop unrolled 2x with a counter to fit the 32-word memory; the fully unrolled version needs 71 words (see alternatives, simulated with PROG_WORDS=72). yosys_cmd: incumbents/yosys.sh -p "read_verilog -sv incumbents/femtorv_bb/femtorv_cfg.v incumbents/femtorv_bb/patched/femtorv32_quark.v incumbents/femtorv_bb/top.v; synth -flatten -top inc_femtorv_bb; stat"
